description: Agent Limits: submit a system’s limit-event records (each block, escalation, queued action, near miss and override, with which limit it hit, what was attempted, the amount, when, what the system did, who was told and who wrote the record) and optionally the limits the system has. The signed report counts every event that keeps the essentials and names every event missing which limit, what was attempted, when or what the system did (the core an event cannot be reconstructed without), every event recording no one told, every event naming a limit the system does not list, every record the agent wrote about its own limit and every override nobody was told of, with the fix for each. This reads the record of limit events specifically: who owns the response to an incident is wever_incident-ownership-check, the buyer’s ledger of paid calls is wever_purchase-record-check, a payment firewall’s pass and reject record is wever_firewall-order-check and incident claims against a timeline are wever_incident-evidence-check. Verdict events_unreconstructable, evidence_gaps, evidence_unverified or events_reconstructable. POST /api/limit-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-limits-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-limits/.

attempted.description: What was attempted, such as a 900 USDC payment to a merchant.

kind.description: A block, an escalation, a queued action, a near miss or an override.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

limits.description: The limits the system has, by name.
